title: Minus 18 and a Toque: The Night the NHL Went Outside
deck: November 22, 2003. 57,167 people in an open stadium in Edmonton, Gretzky and Messier shoveling snow, and a goalie in a wool hat. The first Heritage Classic, the game that took the NHL outdoors for real.

hero.alt: An outdoor NHL rink inside a packed baseball stadium during the 2012 Winter Classic in Philadelphia
